name: Daichyura
description: The Daichyura were a sentient species found in the galaxy during the Galactic War. Humanoid in shape, the species possessed five-fingered hands, small mouths, and had a crest on top of their heads similar to those of Vurk. A Daichyura named Sellexith worked at Star Cluster Casino as a bouncer during a Soovada event.
